bullish.title: Eaton Sees Best Years Ahead as Data Center Demand Powers Growth

bullish.title: Eaton (ETN) Advances While Market Declines: Some Information for Investors

bullish.title: Eaton Corporation Continues to Leverage ISNetworld® to Scale Subcontractor Management Across EMEA
bullish.reason: 透過擴大與 ISN 的合作，優化 EMEA 地區的分包商管理與安全標準，有助於提升營運效率與風險控管。

bullish.title: Eaton vs. Rivian Automotive: Which Industrials Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?

bullish.title: Eaton Announces $1 Million Commitment to Support Global Freshwater Conservation

bearish.title: Eaton Stock Slides Monday: What's Driving the Action?
bearish.reason: 市場對 AI 基礎設施資本支出放緩的擔憂，以及總體經濟不確定性，直接導致股價出現顯著回調。
